title: Reduce filter_map closure capture in live event stream
description:
The live_stream BroadcastStream (line 156 in events.rs) uses filter_map with a closure that captures 'allowed_types: Option<Vec<String>>'. The closure captures the entire Option<Vec<String>> for every event delivered over the connection lifetime.

While the actual overhead is small (at most 3 strings × connection count), this can be improved by pre-computing the filter predicate outside the closure and using a simpler check. Alternative: convert allowed_types to a small compile-time HashMap or use an array of &str instead of Vec<String>.

Impact: Negligible in practice for typical chat load (1-3 subscribers per user), but cleaner stream semantics.
Current behavior: harmless but worth noting for future optimization if per-user subscriber count grows.
